query: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS order_items_seller_read ON public.order_items; CREATE POLICY order_items_seller_read ON public.order_items FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (private.owns_shop(shop_id) OR private.is_platform_admin()); DROP POLICY IF EXISTS orders_seller_read ON public.orders; CREATE POLICY orders_seller_read ON public.orders FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (private.is_platform_admin() OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id = orders.id AND private.owns_shop(oi.shop_id))); DROP POLICY IF EXISTS role_applications_own_submit ON public.role_applications; CREATE POLICY role_applications_own_submit ON public.role_applications FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()) AND status = 'pending' AND reviewer_id IS NULL AND decision_note IS NULL AND reviewed_at IS NULL); DROP POLICY IF EXISTS role_applications_own_edit_pending ON public.role_applications; CREATE POLICY role_applications_own_edit_pending ON public.role_applications FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()) AND status = 'pending') WITH CHECK (user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()) AND status = 'pending' AND reviewer_id IS NULL AND decision_note IS NULL AND reviewed_at IS NULL); CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sync_role_application_profile() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO public, private, pg_catalog AS $function$ BEGIN INSERT INTO public.user_role_profiles (user_id, role_type, status, application_data, approved_at) VALUES (NEW.user_id, NEW.role_type, NEW.status, NEW.application_data, CASE WHEN NEW.status = 'approved' THEN COALESCE(NEW.reviewed_at, timezone('utc', now())) ELSE NULL END) ON CONFLICT (user_id, role_type) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, application_data = EXCLUDED.application_data, approved_at = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.status = 'approved' THEN COALESCE(public.user_role_profiles.approved_at, EXCLUDED.approved_at) WHEN EXCLUDED.status = 'pending' THEN NULL ELSE public.user_role_profiles.approved_at END, updated_at = timezone('utc', now()); RETURN NEW; END; $function$; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION private.sync_role_application_profile() FROM PUBLIC; DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS sync_role_application_profile ON public.role_applications; CREATE TRIGGER sync_role_application_profile AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.role_applications FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.sync_role_application_profile(); DROP POLICY IF EXISTS work_inbox_items_own_mark_read ON public.work_inbox_items; CREATE POLICY work_inbox_items_own_mark_read ON public.work_inbox_items FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (user_id = (SELECT auth.uid())) WITH CHECK (user_id = (SELECT auth.uid())); ALTER FUNCTION public.apply_for_hobee_role(text, jsonb) SECURITY INVOKER; ALTER FUNCTION public.mark_my_hobee_inbox_item_read(uuid, boolean) SECURITY INVOKER; ALTER FUNCTION public.my_hobee_earnings_summary() SECURITY INVOKER; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.apply_for_hobee_role(text, jsonb) FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.mark_my_hobee_inbox_item_read(uuid, boolean) FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.my_hobee_earnings_summary() FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.apply_for_hobee_role(text, jsonb) FROM anon; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.mark_my_hobee_inbox_item_read(uuid, boolean) FROM anon; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.my_hobee_earnings_summary() FROM anon; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.apply_for_hobee_role(text, jsonb) TO authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.mark_my_hobee_inbox_item_read(uuid, boolean) TO authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.my_hobee_earnings_summary() TO authenticated;
